name: Knowledgebases — PDF extraction, knowledge base, search
bootstrap: python3 -c "import starlette, chromadb, pymupdf, hnswlib, qdrant_client" 2>/dev/null || python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt -r tests/requirements-dev.txt
build: python3 -m compileall -q pdfkb serve.py app.py tests
evidence: The web app is Starlette served by serve.py (ASGI app pdfkb.web:app) — not FastAPI, and not app.py, which is the optional Tkinter desktop client.

There is no pytest suite: tests/run_verification.sh boots an isolated instance and runs tests/verify_web.py (HTTP API + the rendered page in headless Chrome, 226 checks) plus tests/verify_library_readonly.py.
The bootstrap is a no-op when the dependencies are already importable, so verification never churns the interpreter it happens to run in.
Every run uses its own temp data directory and port, because the probe resets and purges knowledge bases on purpose.
